### spellguard connect

Connect to a managed agent's box over SSH

- Arguments: `<agent>`, `[command...]`
- Flags: --debug-failed (bool) default: "false" - connect to a FAILED box (its compute still exists) to diagnose why it failed; --wait-warm (bool) default: "false" - wait for the warm daemon before falling back
- Environment: `SPELLGUARD_TOKEN`, `SPELLGUARD_PROFILE`, `SPELLGUARD_ORG`, `SPELLGUARD_BASE_URL`, `SPELLGUARD_FORMAT`, `SPELLGUARD_NO_INTERACTIVE`, `SPELLGUARD_AGENT_MODE`
- Output formats: `table`, `json`, `yaml`
- Result fields: `agentId` (string) - the resolved agent's stable agent id, `name` (string) - agent display name, `sshUser` (string) - resolved SSH login user, `tailscaleHostname` (string) - resolved full MagicDNS hostname (never the bare list hostname), `sshCommand` (string) - ready-to-run `ssh <sshUser>@<tailscaleHostname>`; never re-derive this client-side, `accessModel` (string) - SSH access model (acl or device_share), `accessState` (string) - SSH access lifecycle state (e.g. pending_accept, ready); advisory, `phase` (string enum: own_tailnet|company_connected) - connect phase decided by the reachability probe, `reachable` (boolean) - whether the pre-connect TCP probe to host:22 succeeded, `requiresInteractive` (boolean) - true when the box is only reachable via an interactive in-process session (Phase B) that a non-TTY caller cannot drive, `tailscaleAcceptLink` (string) - Tailscale personal device-share accept URL; present only when accessModel=device_share and accessState=pending_accept (absent/omitted otherwise), `next_steps` (array) - ordered runnable next-step hints on the success path; each element is {label, command} where command is a COMPLETE, copy-pasteable `spellguard …` string for the canonical continuation of this flow (absent when there is none)
- Requires auth: yes
- Permissions: `self`, `org_role:admin`
- Risk level: `write`
- May prompt: yes
- Read only: no
- Mutates state: yes
- Destructive: no
- Idempotent: no
- Examples: `spellguard connect my-agent`, `spellguard connect my-agent --debug-failed`, `spellguard connect my-agent --non-interactive`, `spellguard connect my-agent --format json`, `spellguard connect my-agent -- ls -la`, `spellguard connect my-agent -- git push`, `spellguard connect my-agent -- sh -c 'tail -50 /var/log/syslog | grep error'`
